projections.smoke_minutes: about 25 (load 21 s; 3 buffers at about 70 s; two full saves at about 4.8 min each as in C07; DEV75 about 4 min; resume verification and optimizer load about 3 min); job estimate 40
projections.seconds_per_update: about 35 at the pool's natural lengths (pool prompts mean 1,036 tokens, census completions mean 44 tokens; probe: 32 s natural, 155 s at the cap)
projections.overhead: per 50 updates: full save about 4.8 min, DEV75 about 4 min, restart and resume verification about 3 min; DEV250 about 8 min every 150 updates
projections.updates_per_night: about 1,100 to 1,200 in an uncontended 00:00-16:40 window; about 330 if every completion ran to the 1,024 cap; the 1,500-update limit needs about 1.3 to 1.5 nights
projections.disk: each save about 17.7 GB, retain-all (R7): about 30 evaluation saves for 1,500 updates plus one deadline save per night, about 550-600 GB; /mnt/e had 864 GB free on 2026-10-23; the trainer stops for the user (exit 3) before a save that would leave less than 150 GB

rule_decisions.rule: R4 step 3 (M >= 15% on the latest census) + user decision

inputs.offline_iterations: RFT-1/DPO-1 (T = 1.0) and RFT-2/DPO-2 (T = 1.2) discarded at every gate (status/C13.json)

rule_decisions.outcome: user override: start online GRPO (C14/C15) anyway; every other pre-registered rule stays: the C15 recipe, R6 stop and continue rules, R8 (at most one model upload per night)

decisions_where_the_cards_were_open: Pool: the all-correct sample is 10% of the finished pool (209 = round(1,877 / 9)), not 10% of the 5,505 all-correct prompts; allocated to families in proportion to the all-correct set (largest remainder), seeded (3407) within each family. Built from the T = 1.0 census as instructed.

Reward for advantages: reward v2.1's graded reward (partial credit 'gain', weight 0.5, as the census); 'exact' is logged alongside. All-correct guard prompts are zero-variance until the policy fails one, so they only contribute when forgetting starts.

Rollout buffer: 2 optimizer updates (8 groups = 64 rows). The first update of a buffer is on-policy (ratio exactly 1, TRL's old = logp.detach()); the second uses rollout-time log-probabilities (no grad, micro-batch 1), so the 0.2/0.28 clip is active. Every evaluation step (multiples of 50) and the 1,500 limit end a buffer.

Dynamic sampling: 1.5 x the needed groups per buffer, zero-variance groups dropped, refill up to 4 rounds or 4 x the needed prompts; surplus signal groups are discarded (no carry-over across a save). If refill is exhausted the update trains on the signal groups it has and its empty slots count as 'zero-variance after filtering' (the R6 quantity); an update without any signal group skips the optimizer step but counts.

DAPO normaliser: completion tokens (EOS included) of the update's rows that enter the loss; truncated rows (no end-of-generation before 1,024) are excluded from loss and normaliser but their -0.5 reward stays in the group mean (TRL 0.24 mask_truncated_completions + loss_type dapo). Zero-advantage rows count in the normaliser but skip forward/backward (zero gradient).

LR: hidden 1e-6 / side 1e-7 (a tenth of SFT's 1e-5 / 1e-6), linear warmup where update u uses min(1, u / 10), then constant (the card names no decay). Fresh aurora_mix state, max_grad_norm 0 as in the SFT recipe.
Sampling: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0 and top_k 0 passed explicitly; the arm A checkpoint's generation_config has top_p 0.95 and transformers defaults top_k to 50.

Model load: plain transformers bf16 with SDPA and non-reentrant checkpointing (the probe's measured path). Its 85 layer-norm weights are bf16, while unsloth kept them fp32 in SFT/C13 (arm A stores them as F32); the DEV evaluator also loads them as bf16, so step 0 equals the evaluated model. The optimizer dispatch hash for this load (162a62e5...) is bound in the recipe and checked at start.

R6 at DEV75-only evaluations (50, 100, 200, ...): the R1 rows edit/nofp/valid/cap against the previous evaluation; score250 is compared at the DEV250 evaluations (every 150) against the previous DEV250 evaluation; the first references are arm A 536's gate-536 results. The loss row uses the window's mean update loss.

R6 zero-variance streak: the after-filter share averaged over each evaluation's window of updates, above 50% at three evaluations in a row. Length factor: the window's mean completion length (all generated rows) against the mean over the first 10 updates; beyond x2 or /2 is stop-for-user. Reward hacking (DEV250 evaluations): window reward since the previous DEV250 evaluation above the first-10-update reward while score250 is >= 10 below the starting model's (117) -> rollback.

Saves: full state (weights, optimizer, RNG, sampler cursor) at every evaluation step and at the deadline / stop request, retain-all (R7); the trainer stops for the user (exit 3 via the driver) before a save that would leave < 150 GB on /mnt/e. A deadline stop picks the last buffer boundary where one more buffer + a save + 90 s fits before SEPALITH_DEADLINE_EPOCH; the trainer also honours the runner's stop file directly.

Pilot end: R6 rollback ends the pilot with the last evaluation checkpoint R6 continued from (or arm A 536); R6 stop-for-user exits 3 (override-step-<n>.json + night_queue retry); after the update-1,500 evaluation the pilot is complete. The driver writes pilot-summary.json but does not adopt; adoption for grpo-<n>/ is a morning decision (no rule names an adoption threshold for GRPO). R8: the job summary names the latest DEV250-evaluated checkpoint that passes R1 against the starting model as the nightly candidate.

Smoke: same pre-registered values and code, separate archive and evidence directory; train to update 4 (2 buffers) and save, full DEV75 on checkpoint 4, resume to update 6 and save; exit 1 if any update is missing, the resume is not from checkpoint 4, no optimizer step ran, a checkpoint does not verify, or the DEV75 result does not bind.
Evaluation scheduling: an evaluation starts only with >= 15 min (DEV75) or 45 min (DEV75 + DEV250) before the deadline, a trainer segment only with >= 20 min; otherwise exit 75.
Job priorities: smoke 40, pilot 45 (ahead of the C13 jobs' 50/55; the queue is empty). Absolute air and Rscript paths are bound in the recipe because the systemd runner's PATH lacks ~/.local/bin.
notes: Built and tested, nothing enqueued, no GPU used. The orchestrator reviews, merges, then enqueues the smoke and the pilot (the pilot requires the smoke). After each pilot night: copy the R6 decisions from the job result and the evidence directory here; R8 nightly upload of the night's candidate is morning work.
